$$\mathcal{L} = \sum_{t=1}^{T} \ell(f_\theta(x_t), y_t) \quad \text{s.t.} \quad g^\top g_{\text{ref}} \geq 0$$
import torch

def project(g, g_ref):
    """A-GEM: project the gradient when it conflicts with the reference."""
    dot = torch.dot(g, g_ref)
    if dot >= 0:
        return g
    return g - dot / g_ref.dot(g_ref) * g_ref
